answer.intro: Twikka is a habit-building app that helps people become more active - and stay that way.
answer.description: It's not about workouts, reps, or leaderboards. Twikka is for real people who want to move a little more, feel better, and build a routine that lasts.

points.science: Backed by science and built with care
points.sustainability: Focused on sustainability, not short bursts
points.designed: Designed for people who've tried before - and want it to stick this time
points.social: Includes social features, challenges, and encouragement to help you stay on track

answer.conclusion: Whether you're starting from scratch or starting over, Twikka meets you where you are.

answer.intro: Most fitness apps assume you're already motivated. Twikka helps you build motivation.
answer.description: There are plenty of tools for runners, lifters, and gym junkies. Twikka is different. It's designed for people who want to create an active lifestyle - but don't know where to begin (or have tried and stopped before).

points.steps: Encourages small steps, not big promises
points.progress: Tracks progress over time, not perfection
points.science: Uses principles from behavioural science and the Swedish FaR model
points.support: Offers structure, support, and community - not guilt

answer.conclusion: Our goal is to help you go from "I should be doing more" to "This is just part of my life now."

answer.intro: Start simple. Check in. Grow your habit.
answer.description: Twikka is built around a clear, science-based loop:

plan.title: Create a Weekly Plan
plan.description: Answer a few questions, and the app helps you design a realistic activity template - cardio, strength, or both.

checkins.title: Daily Check-Ins
checkins.description: Log what you did - or why you didn't. You'll see a visual record of your progress over time.

adapt.title: Adapt as You Go
adapt.description: As the app learns about you, it helps fine-tune your plan. You'll also get tips, nudges, and encouragement to stay on track.

join.title: Join In
join.description: Participate in challenges, connect with others, and build accountability through supportive groups and events.

answer.conclusion: The goal isn't to do more - it's to do what's right for you, consistently.

answer.intro: If you've ever said "I should get back into exercise" - this is for you.

points.tried: You've started and stopped exercise routines in the past
points.notFitness: You don't feel like a "fitness person"
points.support: You want support and structure, but not pressure
points.change: You want to make a change that actually sticks this time

answer.conclusion: It's also great for small groups, clubs, community organisations, or even workplaces that want to get active together.

meta.title: About {siteName} - Our Mission & Story
meta.description: Learn about Twikka, the health and fitness app designed to help you build sustainable healthy habits. Discover our mission, values, and the team behind the app.

founder.intro1: I'm a podiatrist by profession, with experience in both private practice and the academic world. I hold an honours degree, a postgraduate diploma, and a Master's degree, and I am a graduate of the Australian Institute of Company Directors. I'm also a member of Sports Medicine Australia.
founder.intro2: Alongside my clinical work, I've always had a strong interest in software and technology - something that's run in parallel with my health career for years.
founder.intro3: Over the past two decades, I've also taken on various governance roles. I'm currently Chair of Melville Cares, and have previously served as Chair of Advocare and as President of the Australasian Podiatry Council. I've always gravitated toward roles that serve the community and help improve people's lives.

earlyDays.title: Early Days in Lycra
earlyDays.paragraph1: In my twenties, I worked in the fitness industry as an aerobics and gym instructor. It was a great way to meet people from all walks of life and see how movement can change lives - whether you're an elite athlete or just getting started.
earlyDays.paragraph2: While I admired the discipline of serious sportspeople, I was often more inspired by those who were taking their first steps. Starting from zero can be daunting, but those who stuck with it often saw incredible improvements - not just physically, but in confidence, mood and overall quality of life. Getting fitter, I learned, is one of those things that tends to sell itself.

losingRhythm.title: Losing the Rhythm
losingRhythm.paragraph1: Of course, life gets in the way. In my 30s and 40s, the demands of parenting, work, and a thousand small distractions led me to slow down and gain weight. Fitness isn't something you can stash away for later - you have to keep working at it!
losingRhythm.paragraph2: Only recently have I restarted my own journey toward better health. This time, I'm taking it gently, enjoying the process, and playing the long game.

whyTwikka.title: Why Twikka?
whyTwikka.paragraph1: After years of working one-on-one with patients, I wanted to be part of something that could reach more people - something that brought together my clinical experience, my background in tech, and my belief in practical, scientifically grounded solutions.
whyTwikka.paragraph2: Twikka grew out of that desire: an app built not for elite athletes, but for real people who want to move more, feel better, and make it stick.
whyTwikka.paragraph3: After a couple of years of refining the concept, Twikka is ready for the world - and I'm excited to see where it goes next!

account.question: How do I reset my password or change my email?
account.answer: You can manage your password and email from inside the Twikka app under Settings → Account. If you can't access your account, send us a message above and include the email you signed up with so we can help.

bug.question: How do I report a bug effectively?
bug.answer: Please include: what you were trying to do, what happened instead, your device and OS version, and your Twikka app version (Settings → About). Screenshots or short screen recordings help us reproduce and fix issues faster.

data.question: How do I request my data or delete my account?
data.answer: You can request a copy or deletion of your data at any time. Email support@twikka.com from the address linked to your account, or use the form above and select 'Data, Privacy or Deletion'. We process requests within 30 days as required by GDPR.
